note: Build-tool advisories reviewed by hand. Shipped dependencies are never allow-listed: scripts/check-npm-advisories.mjs fails on any advisory npm audit --omit=dev reports. Each entry expires so it is reviewed again; remove an entry once npm audit stops reporting it.

advisories.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. braces is reached only through Tailwind CSS 3 build tooling (chokidar, micromatch, fast-glob), whose patterns come from tailwind.config.ts in this repository, never from users. Nothing from this chain ships in the app. No fixed braces release exists; the fix is Tailwind 4.
Quadratic parsing of flat selectors. Reached only through Tailwind CSS 3 (postcss-nested) at build time, on this repository's own CSS. Nothing from this chain ships in the app; the fix is Tailwind 4.
